description: This file defines the EmployeeAnniversaryModel class within the OrangeHRM project. It models an employee's anniversary data, including associated employee information, job title details, and joined date, and is intended for API serialization.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversaryModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee anniversary information, integrating employee and job title data for API responses.
